name: Beans of Love
source:
Our heroine, Saki, is one of the female devils living on the devil island. While having a crush on the leader, Nayuki, lately her chances to meet him have seemed to lessen. Although he had promised to marry her when they where kids, the answer to if he still remembers about that or not is also unclear…

"Nothing will come from it, if you just keep waiting. If you really love him, then Saki should be the one to act first!"

After being scolded by her best friend, Hana, she decides to begin her ‘attack’.

Now then, the final destination of Saki’s love is…?

[from [url=https://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/09/24/otome-game-review-tics-special/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
